name: Corniche el-Nil
description: The central waterfront strip along the Nile, lined with hotels, cafes and the felucca docks. It offers the classic Aswan view over the river and Elephantine Island, with easy access to the souk, ferries and boat trips.
bestFor: First-time visitors wanting Nile views, boats and central sightseeing access

name: Elephantine Island (Nubian villages)
description: A car-free island in the Nile with two Nubian villages, painted houses and palm gardens. Reached only by small ferry, it offers a peaceful, community-rooted stay in guesthouses amid ancient ruins and quiet lanes.
bestFor: Travellers wanting an authentic, quiet Nubian island stay away from traffic

name: Sharia el-Souq (Market Street)
description: The lively covered bazaar area one block back from the Corniche, packed with spice stalls, textiles and cheap eateries. Budget hotels and hostels cluster here, putting you in the middle of Aswan daily commerce and street life.
bestFor: Budget travellers wanting cheap stays in the heart of the market

name: West Bank (Gharb Aswan)
description: The Nile west bank below the Tombs of the Nobles, with Nubian guesthouses, sandy lanes and desert scenery. Reached by ferry, it offers tranquil sunsets, camel tracks and a slower, rural pace across from the busy town.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting quiet desert-and-river scenery and slow pace
